_comment: tree-a only (coordinator decision on the gate-5 round-3 report, options a + b, 2026-11-24): rules/jlc-4layer.json with min clearance and min track 0.10 (JLC 4-layer minimum 0.09 = 3.5 mil, 10 % margin), so the Default and Power class clearance 0.10 of board.yaml and the 0.10 signal necks the router needs are legal.
